examples.english: I keep koi in the garden pond.

notes:
{鯉|こい} refers to carp - a large freshwater fish that holds special cultural significance in Japan.

WRITING:
The kanji {鯉|こい} combines ⟦{魚|うお}→魚：00499_sakana⟧ (fish) and ⟦{里|さと}→里：02214_sato⟧ (village), suggesting a fish commonly found near human settlements.

TYPES OF CARP:
- ⟦{真鯉|まごい}→真鯉：noentry⟧: common carp (wild, dark-colored)
- ⟦{錦鯉|にしきごい}→錦鯉：14513_nishikigoi⟧: ornamental koi (colorful varieties bred for beauty)
- ⟦{緋鯉|ひごい}→緋鯉：noentry⟧: red carp

CULTURAL NOTE:
Carp symbolize strength, perseverance, and success in Japan. According to Chinese legend, carp that swim upstream and leap over the Dragon Gate waterfall transform into dragons - representing determination and achievement.

CHILDREN'S DAY (⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧):
- ⟦{鯉|こい}のぼり→鯉のぼり：05711_koinobori⟧: carp-shaped streamers/windsocks
- Flown outside homes on May 5th
- Traditionally displayed for boys to wish them strength and success
- Usually includes: black ⟦{真鯉|まごい}→真鯉：noentry⟧ (father), red ⟦{緋鯉|ひごい}→緋鯉：noentry⟧ (mother), and smaller colored carp (children)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {鯉|こい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{滝登|たきのぼ}り→滝登り：noentry⟧: carp climbing a waterfall (metaphor for perseverance leading to success)
- ⟦{登竜門|とうりゅうもん}→登竜門：28090_touryuumon⟧: gateway to success (from the Dragon Gate legend)

WATCH OUT:
- {鯉|こい} (こい): carp (fish)
- ⟦{恋|こい}→恋：02208_koi⟧ (こい): romantic love
Same pronunciation, completely different meanings!
